comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record assembles two aligned flanges with four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade latch release and withdrawal versus large-part pose alignment and repeated pin insertion through matched holes.
comparison.success_condition: Isolated extraction without damage versus specified flange poses, hole registration, and four inserted pins.
comparison.reason: Inverse motion alone is not decisive, but the record lacks wire deflection and compliant latch-release mechanics.
